hypothesis: A shared permutation-invariant encoder over amplitude and local phase advance learns a reusable system representation rather than only helping a fixed supervised inverse model.

pretraining.objective: symmetric cross-view system contrastive learning with anti-collapse regularization

gates.fair_budget: one shared checkpoint for every source/frequency budget; no parameter growth with view count
gates.frozen_transfer_vs_raw: at least 30% lower contrast relative L2 on at least two label budgets
gates.frozen_transfer_vs_amplitude: at least 15% lower contrast relative L2 on at least two label budgets
gates.direction_stability: same direction for every formal seed
gates.multiscale_promotion: promote only if it improves at least two hard shifts over the single-scale token

stop_rules: Do not add attention before the shared mean/std set encoder is evaluated.
Do not add spectral phase advance before M0 frozen transfer passes.
Do not interpret saturated 24-way retrieval as sufficient evidence.
